assumptions: Temporary scratch state under /tmp, /var/tmp and a non-root absolute TMPDIR is disposable
Directory stat/access probes use existence/access/ownership, with directory listings still tracked
Final-output equivalence within a command; concurrent external writes and intermediate external observations are outside this effect policy

Read-only regular workspace files opened for content use content, mtime, size and access metadata as application data; inode and ctime are validation witnesses. Identity/ctime drift requires a content hash match. Metadata-only inputs and files outside the workspace retain strict identity metadata. This opt-in policy is stronger against preserved-mtime content edits than original Incr.

Private cache payloads are trusted, as in original Incr. Cached stdout, stderr and filesystem payload bytes are not rehashed solely for integrity; missing/nonregular payloads and application dependencies remain checked. External modification of private cache bytes is outside this contract.

Speculative stdin is queued in RAM, as in original Incr, so hashing can finish ahead of a slow child and cancel it on a cache hit. Sufficient RAM is assumed; large input backlogs can consume substantial memory. Ordered speculative output retains a 64 MiB memory threshold and temporary-file overflow.

execution.followup_policy: Require three complete paired repetitions in each fresh full cohort. Add independent matched samples if results remain unstable or borderline; retain all failures and do not assert unsupported speedups.
execution.mode_order: Bash reference first; alternate original/Observe ordering between paired repetitions. Preserve actual starting order in each run configuration.
execution.cleanup: Inspect and record an owned cleanup plan; preserve result evidence and recovery snapshots; prepare inputs separately from measurement
execution.freezing: Archive exact manifests, sources, binaries, benchmark scripts, supplemental Node runtime/modules, input inventories and package/tool versions
execution.cold_definition: Cold means an empty Incr result cache at the start of an ordered script sequence, not an empty operating-system page cache. Fixture copying and input/model provenance hashing run outside the timer for every mode; no global page-cache flush is used.
execution.fresh_reproduction: New owned study workspace, fixture state and caches on the pushed runtime checkpoint; serial historical 828-invocation cohort followed by a separate full supplemental 45-invocation cohort. No tests, builds, preparation or bulk evidence hashing/compression overlap timed measurements.

validation: Exact native return status, stdout hash, normalized stderr and full nested output manifests
Documented archive/encryption decoding and provenance normalization only; no changes to workload payload comparisons
Independent workload artifact checks, including complete article visits and every expected Tufte city-year PNG
Record resources, cache reuse, process cleanup, failures and excluded/incomplete samples
Never treat a failed sequence, unsupported input or instrumentation bypass as acceleration

DPT stderr additionally normalizes only the exact TensorFlow NodeDef optional use_unbounded_threadpool compatibility notice for ParallelMapDatasetV2/_14. Changed attributes, other notices, errors and tracebacks remain compared; application output checks are unchanged.

reporting.primary: Incremental edited-version ratios, paired by identical input and script version
also_required: Per-version samples, means, medians, spread and resource usage
All slowdowns and correctness failures, with no selective omission
reporting.uncertainty: Use repeated paired observations; investigate unstable or borderline results before making a faster-than-baseline claim
reporting.monitoring: Persistent supervised jobs with live heartbeats, disk/process guards and periodic independent audits of saved validation evidence
reporting.bash_sanity_gate: Both Incr systems must be compared against native Bash, including edited-version and whole-sequence totals. Investigate systematic or substantial slowdowns; disclose any limited exceptions rather than presenting baseline-relative gains as Bash speedups.
reporting.historical_sanity_gate: Compare current Bash and original Incr against recorded original results for matching workloads and actual sizes. Investigate large discrepancies and identify annotation/configuration differences, reconstruction differences and timing-method changes explicitly.
